verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing platform, so this axis applies. The evidence shows virtual card issuance and merchant, category, and ID blocking, but nothing documents issuing cards to AI agents by name. There is also no evidence of per-card amount caps or expiry controls. Its MCP server only looks up API endpoints and generates code samples, so it does not count toward agent card access. These are general building blocks, not the named agent-card capability the story requires.
